prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: waiting for the loss adjuster. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If we appoint a loss adjuster, please wait for them to contact you before carrying out any permanent repairs. You should, however, take reasonable temporary measures to prevent further loss or damage."},{"type":"fact","content":"Do not dispose of damaged items until the loss adjuster has had the opportunity to inspect them, unless they present a health or safety risk. This is particularly important where the cause of damage is not yet clear."},{"type":"fact","content":"If the loss adjuster asks you to obtain estimates, please wait for confirmation of the works to be priced and compared.
